meta.methodology: Cost index tracks four input baskets priced monthly against the 2026-01 base of 100: hot-rolled/forging-grade steel bar, PP/PE plastic resin, pallet-grade softwood lumber, and ocean freight (Taiwan/China to Rotterdam, Los Angeles, Southampton, and Yokohama base ports), each converted through TWD and CNY spot FX against USD/EUR. TW and CN indices are weighted and published separately per SKU since the two supply bases move on different cost drivers (Taiwan: energy, TWD, forging labor; China: RMB, coastal logistics, resin feedstock). Weighting is fixed per product category (steel-dominant tools weight steel ~70%, freight ~15%, FX ~15%; packaging materials weight lumber/resin/paper ~60%, freight ~30%, FX ~10%). Index refreshes monthly on the 20th. This index is a directional cost-trend signal for planning only — no FOB or landed prices are published anywhere on this site.
